name: Playwright Open-Source Browser Testing
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source local end-to-end browser testing for Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; no vendor-imposed test-run limit or software subscription.
watch_out: Runs browsers on your own machine, containers or CI runners. Compute, storage, artifacts and any hosted browser grid cost extra. This listing is for the Playwright test framework, not a managed testing SaaS tier.
